outcome_regression: signed next-day SPX return of the sign-only strategy
outcome_classification: one when signed next-day SPX return is negative
requested_future_feature: next_day_spot_return_squared is known only after the trade and is an ex-post magnitude diagnostic, not a tradable predictor
atm_variance: front-week ATM implied volatility squared and divided by DAYS_PER_YEAR=252
today_return: same-date spot_ref divided by the preceding panel date spot_ref minus one
classifier_validation: expanding window after 60 observations; L2 logistic regularization only in the expanding fit
methodology: full-sample strategy diagnostic; not a look-ahead-free backtest
